name: jobs-tools
description: External jobs consumer: exposes the jobs@1 capability as the tools 'jobs start', 'jobs list', 'jobs status', 'jobs logs', 'jobs stop', 'jobs cleanup' and 'jobs policy' - provider agnostic, no backend named

config.description: The consumer only shapes the tools it registers; the log directory, the job ceiling, the log cap and the kill grace belong to the provider's row.

pageBytes.description: Byte window the 'jobs logs' tool uses when the call names none (the provider's own default and cap still apply).
